entries.name: Eesti Maaülikool Väikeloomakliinik (Small Animal Clinic, Estonian University of Life Sciences)
entries.duty: Emergency care 24/7. Phone 09:00-20:00 +372 731 3224, night 20:00-09:00 +372 503 3878 (on-duty vet). Call before coming; critical patients are seen first and you may be referred elsewhere if the clinic is full.
entries.note: Emergency-care page confirms 24/7 and both phones and address.

entries.name: PetCity Loomakliinik Rannamõisa (PetCity lemmikute kiirabi)
entries.duty: Pet emergency clinic, open 24 hours every day including public holidays, with a vet and assistant on site. Phone +372 602 0888 or short number 15222. Call ahead because doors are locked after regular hours; a 50% surcharge applies to out-of-hours emergency visits.
entries.note: Own petcity.ee page opened 2026-11-05: 'E-P 24H avatud'; 'võtame vastu loomi 24/7, ka riigipühadel'; 'on kohapeal ööpäevaringselt loomaarst koos assistendiga'; 602 0888, header 15222; surcharge 50% (windows 20-10 / 21-09 given).

entries.name: Loomade Kiirabikliinik (Evidensia)
entries.duty: Animal emergency clinic open 24 hours, 7 days a week; call ahead on +372 502 3191. Out-of-hours visits carry a surcharge.
entries.note: Own Evidensia page opened 2026-11-05: every day listed 'Avatud ööpäeva ringselt', 'Hädaabiteenus'; email kiirabikliinik@evidensia.ee. Earlier note (embassy list, no hours) superseded. Surcharge from ERR article (60-90 EUR).

entries.name: Tartu Väikeloomakliinik (Evidensia)
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week for emergencies (appointments Mon-Fri 09:00-19:00). Phone ahead before arriving at the emergency department so the team can prepare.
entries.note: Own page: lists 24 h/7 days and asks to call before coming ('Erakorralise meditsiini osakonda tulles palume meile ette helistada'); moved to Kalda tee 41 on 1 July 2026; email tartuloomakliinik@evidensia.ee. ERR article mentioned a 90 EUR out-of-hours fee (not on page).

notes: Estonia follow-up 2026-11-05. Own sites now reached via domain-restricted searches (evidensia.ee, petcity.ee). Verified 24 h: EMU Tartu small animal clinic, PetCity Rannamõisa (Tallinn), Loomade kiirabikliinik (Tallinn), Evidensia Tartu Väikeloomakliinik. Not reachable / skip, unreachable twice: PetCity Pärnu and Eedeni pages on petcity.ee, petcity blog on 15222, viljandiloomakliinik.ee (client/server error), hiiumaa.ee (robots), facebook.com Saaremaa Loomakliinik (robots), veterinaar.ee (robots), rus.vetdok.eu (robots), koer.ee Haapsalu/Kuressaare lists (aggregator, error), vastriku.ee, toometikliinik.ee, loomaarstid/koda sites not surfaced. Still missing (no own site opened): Saaremaa/Kuressaare (Saaremaa Loomakliinik Pikk 61, Saaremaa Veterinaarkeskus), Haapsalu, Viljandi (Männimäe loomakliinik), Hiiumaa Loomakliinik (phone 5670 6709 only seen on a shelter page), Otepää (Kredo), Pae Loomakliinik 24h (phone 5662 9100, page title says 24h, no city/address; not added). No official duty-rota page: PTA page offers only the register of licensed vets and office line 605 1710. No animal poison line found (shelter page lists a 'veterinary advice line 9000 112' without details - not added). Västriku address on own site is Västriku 2a vs 2b in existing entry (existing left unchanged).
